title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Personal Item Charges Secured by an Additional Deposit
content:
**Ancillary item charges note — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The personal-item allowance of the additional deposit is read from the item charges posted to the resident's **Ancillary and Optional Services Billing** account within the last three months — entries whose date is fewer than three whole calendar months before the day the deposit is worked out.

| Item charges posted in the last three months | Personal-item allowance |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | Their total divided by 3 |
| 1 or 2 | The latest item charge (the one posted first where two share a posting date) |
| None | No allowance |

**Hypothetical cases, at the published ancillary prices.** A wash and set at 28.00, a hair color at 54.00 and a barber shave at 12.00 in the window: 94.00 divided by 3, that is 31.333…, carried unrounded into the deposit, which is rounded once on its final figure. A single permanent wave at 68.00: 68.00.
